end.summary: Matched some everyday objects with cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere; this was practised and needs checking again for steadiness.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming the five 3D shapes and matching them to objects such as dice, a brick, a battery, a football and a lemon. Ishita used useful clues such as flat faces, curved surfaces, corners and a point. They still mixed up whether a cylinder remains the same shape when lying down; this was not corrected by the last time it appeared. At home, show a tin or battery in different positions and ask, “What shape is it now, and why?”
